entries.definition: Valorar con mucho cuidado las cualidades o el alcance de algo.
entries.example: Antes de publicar la acusación, conviene aquilatar el valor de cada testimonio.
entries.levelRationale: Production B2 evaluar (es-sk:b2:i25125) covers broad assessment. Aquilatar adds formal rigorous calibration of evidential worth; the selected use weighs testimony without claiming proof. The distinction is precision of appraisal, not precious-metal testing. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Production B2 evaluar (es-sk:b2:i25125) covers broad assessment. Aquilatar adds formal rigorous calibration of evidential worth; the selected use weighs testimony without claiming proof. The distinction is precision of appraisal, not precious-metal testing. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Resolver una controversia o un desacuerdo mediante una decisión.
entries.example: La comisión debe dirimir la controversia entre los dos departamentos sobre quién autorizó el gasto.
entries.levelRationale: Unlike deciding a personal preference, the verb frames an authoritative resolution between competing positions. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Unlike deciding a personal preference, the verb frames an authoritative resolution between competing positions. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Distinguir con precisión aspectos que pueden confundirse.
entries.example: El informe procura deslindar la responsabilidad política de la responsabilidad administrativa.
entries.levelRationale: The target is conceptual responsibility boundaries, not physically separating objects; learners must preserve the distinction without implying exoneration. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: The target is conceptual responsibility boundaries, not physically separating objects; learners must preserve the distinction without implying exoneration. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Deducir una conclusión a partir de indicios o datos.
entries.example: De su silencio no cabe colegir que haya aceptado todas las condiciones.
entries.levelRationale: Formal inference under negation: absence of speech does not license a conclusion; this is not a synonym for knowing or proving. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Formal inference under negation: absence of speech does not license a conclusion; this is not a synonym for knowing or proving. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Ambigüedad de una expresión que permite entenderla de más de una manera.
entries.example: El contrato habla de «la autorización del representante»; esa anfibología no aclara si él autoriza o necesita ser autorizado.
entries.levelRationale: Identifies two grammatical readings of the same wording, rather than uncertain facts or the self-contradiction taught by B2 paradoja (es-sk:b2:i71840). Intentional wordplay is a separate sense. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Identifies two grammatical readings of the same wording, rather than uncertain facts or the self-contradiction taught by B2 paradoja (es-sk:b2:i71840). entries.definition: Reserva o precisión que limita el alcance de una afirmación o un acuerdo.
entries.example: Aceptamos el calendario con la salvedad de que las fechas dependen del permiso municipal.
entries.levelRationale: A qualification limits assent without necessarily rejecting it; distinguish this pragmatic reservation from an exception already realized. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: A qualification limits assent without necessarily rejecting it; distinguish this pragmatic reservation from an exception already realized. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: De manera directa, sin rodeos ni expresiones que oculten lo que se quiere decir.
entries.example: Le pidió que dijera sin ambages si apoyaría la propuesta, aunque la respuesta resultara incómoda.
entries.levelRationale: Directness is a deliberate stance despite interpersonal cost; formal expression must be distinguished from aggression or certainty. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Directness is a deliberate stance despite interpersonal cost; formal expression must be distinguished from aggression or certainty. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Distinguir o analizar detalles muy sutiles.
entries.example: Hay que hilar fino para distinguir una crítica al método de un ataque a quien lo aplica.
entries.levelRationale: Interprets a figurative demand for fine distinctions in a face-sensitive criticism; literal sewing and needless complication are excluded. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Interprets a figurative demand for fine distinctions in a face-sensitive criticism; literal sewing and needless complication are excluded. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Añadir a algo una complicación innecesaria.
entries.example: Exigir otra firma para confirmar las tres anteriores sería rizar el rizo.
entries.levelRationale: The selected use criticizes excessive refinement; the negative stance must be inferred, not translated as an actual curl. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: The selected use criticizes excessive refinement; the negative stance must be inferred, not translated as an actual curl. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.term: encontrar la horma de su zapato
entries.normalizedTerm: encontrar la horma de su zapato
entries.definition: Encontrar a alguien capaz de hacer frente a las propias exigencias o de frenar los propios abusos.
entries.example: El negociador, acostumbrado a imponer sus condiciones, encontró la horma de su zapato en la nueva portavoz.
entries.translation: naraziť na seberovného súpera; nájsť si svojho majstra
entries.levelRationale: The context frames a check on dominance, not romantic compatibility; possessive and perspective must track the person being challenged. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: The context frames a check on dominance, not romantic compatibility; possessive and perspective must track the person being challenged. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Actuar de manera calculada para obtener un beneficio propio.
entries.example: Si mencionó la vacante delante del director, fue por algo: no da puntada sin hilo.
entries.translation: nič nerobiť bez vypočítavého zámeru získať vlastný prospech

entries.placementRationale: An apparently casual remark is read as strategic self-interest; the expression attributes a motive without proving it. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Intentar obtener una ventaja sin exponerse al riesgo o al compromiso que suele acompañarla.
entries.example: Apoya la protesta en privado, pero no firma el manifiesto; quiere nadar y guardar la ropa.
entries.translation: chcieť získať výhodu a pritom nič neriskovať
entries.levelRationale: The idiom criticizes an attempt to combine benefit with protected noncommitment; it does not assert that the strategy succeeded. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: The idiom criticizes an attempt to combine benefit with protected noncommitment; it does not assert that the strategy succeeded. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.term: arrimar el ascua a su sardina
entries.normalizedTerm: arrimar el ascua a su sardina
entries.definition: Orientar una situación o un argumento hacia el propio beneficio.
entries.example: En el debate sobre el presupuesto, cada departamento intentó arrimar el ascua a su sardina.
entries.translation: obracať situáciu vo svoj prospech; prihrievať si vlastnú polievočku
entries.levelRationale: Identifies self-serving framing within a collective discussion; distinguish legitimate interest from the speaker's critical insinuation. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Identifies self-serving framing within a collective discussion; distinguish legitimate interest from the speaker's critical insinuation. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Cuando ya ha pasado la ocasión de actuar y se juzga lo ocurrido con ventaja retrospectiva.
entries.example: A toro pasado, todos sabían qué inversión había que evitar.
entries.translation: dodatočne, keď už pominula možnosť konať
entries.levelRationale: The ironic claim targets hindsight presented as foresight; the temporal phrase is not simply later. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: The ironic claim targets hindsight presented as foresight; the temporal phrase is not simply later. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Por ser o por tener la cualidad que se expresa a continuación.
entries.example: A fuer de prudente, dejó pasar una oportunidad que no volvió a presentarse.
entries.translation: pre určitú vlastnosť (napr. z opatrnosti); vzhľadom na to, že je
entries.levelRationale: Literary causal construction links a normally positive trait to an adverse outcome; distinguish cause from purpose or concession. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Literary causal construction links a normally positive trait to an adverse outcome; distinguish cause from purpose or concession. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: En favor de un fin al que se da prioridad.
entries.example: En aras de la transparencia, publicaron incluso los datos que perjudicaban su propia imagen.
entries.translation: v záujme; v prospech uprednostneného cieľa
entries.levelRationale: Formal prioritization suggests a cost accepted for a stated value; learners should not assume every invocation genuinely justifies the sacrifice. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Formal prioritization suggests a cost accepted for a stated value; learners should not assume every invocation genuinely justifies the sacrifice. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Teniendo en consideración un hecho o una circunstancia.
entries.example: Habida cuenta de que el plazo ya había vencido, la petición se tramitó como una excepción.
entries.levelRationale: Recognizes a fixed formal premise marker, including de que before a clause, without treating it as evidence that the decision was mandatory. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Recognizes a fixed formal premise marker, including de que before a clause, without treating it as evidence that the decision was mandatory. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Para añadir otra razón que refuerza lo que ya se ha expuesto.
entries.example: El acta carece de firma; a mayor abundamiento, la fecha tampoco coincide con la de la reunión.
entries.levelRationale: Marks a reinforcing argument beyond an already sufficient point in formal discourse, rather than a neutral addition to a list. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Marks a reinforcing argument beyond an already sufficient point in formal discourse, rather than a neutral addition to a list. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Expresión con la que se reconoce y se acepta una repetición de significado.
entries.example: Necesitamos un consenso compartido, valga la redundancia, antes de anunciar el acuerdo.
entries.levelRationale: Metalinguistic aside acknowledges pleonasm; recognize the speaker's self-awareness without treating the formula as an apology for factual error. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Metalinguistic aside acknowledges pleonasm; recognize the speaker's self-awareness without treating the formula as an apology for factual error. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Fórmula formal para pedir permiso antes de intervenir.
entries.example: Con la venia, quisiera señalar una contradicción entre ambas declaraciones.
entries.levelRationale: Formula regulates permission to speak in highly formal, especially courtroom, settings; courtroom convention is register evidence, not procedural advice. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Formula regulates permission to speak in highly formal, especially courtroom, settings; courtroom convention is register evidence, not procedural advice. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Hacer un ofrecimiento solo por cumplir, sin verdadera intención de llevarlo a cabo.
entries.example: Dijo con la boca pequeña que podía ayudar con la mudanza, pero enseguida empezó a poner excusas.

entries.levelRationale: An apparent offer is interpreted as social compliance rather than genuine willingness; the idiom is not about low voice volume. entries.term: tirar la piedra y esconder la mano
entries.normalizedTerm: tirar la piedra y esconder la mano
entries.definition: Provocar un daño o un conflicto y ocultar la propia responsabilidad.
entries.example: Difundir el rumor sin firmarlo fue tirar la piedra y esconder la mano.
entries.translation: ublížiť či vyvolať spor a zatajiť vlastnú účasť
entries.levelRationale: Decodes an accusation combining provocation and concealed agency; neither simple secrecy nor literal stone throwing captures it. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Decodes an accusation combining provocation and concealed agency; neither simple secrecy nor literal stone throwing captures it. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Expresión usada para criticar que alguien cambia lo que había afirmado.
entries.example: Ayer garantizaban que no habría recortes y hoy, donde dije digo, digo Diego, anuncian nuevas restricciones.
entries.translation: beriem späť, čo som povedal; teraz už tvrdím niečo iné
entries.levelRationale: Metalinguistic wordplay mocks reversal of commitment, rather than merely reporting correction of an innocent slip. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: Metalinguistic wordplay mocks reversal of commitment, rather than merely reporting correction of an innocent slip. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.term: a buen entendedor, pocas palabras bastan
entries.normalizedTerm: a buen entendedor, pocas palabras bastan
entries.definition: Expresión que indica que una insinuación basta para comprender un mensaje.
entries.example: El director recordó quién renovaba los contratos y añadió: «A buen entendedor, pocas palabras bastan».
entries.levelRationale: A proverb functions here as a veiled threat through power and context; the expression itself is not inherently threatening. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: A proverb functions here as a veiled threat through power and context; the expression itself is not inherently threatening. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.term: como quien no quiere la cosa
entries.normalizedTerm: como quien no quiere la cosa
entries.definition: Con apariencia de casualidad o de falta de intención.

entries.translation: akoby len tak mimochodom; so zdanlivou nenútenosťou

entries.placementRationale: Distinguishes outward casualness from the narrator's suspicion of a concealed aim; genuine indifference is not entailed. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Expresión que introduce una formulación más fuerte que la anterior, presentándola como si se evitara.

entries.translation: ak nie rovno; aby som nepovedal
entries.levelRationale: A pretended restraint actually intensifies criticism; the second description is evoked rather than simply withdrawn. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: A pretended restraint actually intensifies criticism; the second description is evoked rather than simply withdrawn. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Reunir valor para afrontar algo que produce miedo, dolor o rechazo.

entries.translation: premôcť sa; pozbierať odvahu napriek vnútornému odporu
entries.levelRationale: The example requires overcoming hurt and resistance to perform a social duty; it is not emotional indifference. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.
entries.placementRationale: The example requires overcoming hurt and resistance to perform a social duty; it is not emotional indifference. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.placementRationale: Interpersonal reserve negotiates power and familiarity without necessarily implying hostility; literal spatial distance is excluded. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Adaptarse a las circunstancias o a lo que otros desean para evitar un enfrentamiento.

entries.placementRationale: Accommodation can preserve negotiation without endorsing claims; learners must distinguish pragmatic compromise from agreement. Provisional C2 practice selection: earlier acquisition is possible; no exclusive or official word-level claim.

entries.definition: Malestar interior que queda después de algo que ha dolido o disgustado.

entries.definition: Razonamiento que usa como premisa aquello mismo que pretende demostrar.

entries.definition: Con los cambios necesarios para adaptar una comparación a otro caso.

spanish.definition: Una evaluación del valor de algo

entries.definition: Cantidad que queda después de utilizar, vender o repartir una parte.

entries.levelRationale: Residual stock after distribution, not defective stock necessarily. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.register: neutral or formal; purchases and contracts

english.definition: something left after other parts have been taken away

he threw away the rest

entries.definition: Dejar sin efecto un contrato o un acuerdo.
entries.example: Ambas partes acordaron rescindir el contrato de suministro.
entries.levelRationale: Ending contractual effect, not merely postponing performance. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.register: neutral or formal; purchases and contracts

spanish.definition: anular al suprimir o rescindir

english.definition: cancel officially
examples: He revoked the ban on smoking
lift an embargo
vacate a death sentence

entries.definition: Que impone condiciones desproporcionadamente favorables a una de las partes.

entries.register: neutral or formal; purchases and contracts
entries.placementRationale: The penalty clause exemplifies an imbalance favoring one party, rather than merely a demanding agreement.

entries.definition: Restitución realizada mediante bienes en lugar de dinero.

entries.register: neutral or formal; purchases and contracts
entries.placementRationale: The goods-versus-money distinction is an economic use of especie, not biological classification.

evidence.paraphrase: The expression en especie means in goods rather than money. Applying this to repayment is compositional; no separate fixed-expression headword is claimed.

entries.definition: Como pago parcial que se descontará de una cantidad total.

entries.levelRationale: Advance partial payment, excluding causal on-account-of sense. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.register: neutral or formal; purchases and contracts
entries.placementRationale: The advance payment is credited against a later total, rather than an extra independent charge.

entries.definition: Capacidad de juzgar o actuar con equilibrio sin dejarse arrastrar por preferencias o emociones.
entries.example: Intentó valorar con ecuanimidad las dos propuestas, aunque una procedía de un amigo.

entries.placementRationale: The friend's proposal tests balanced judgment against personal preference, distinguishing impartial assessment from indifference.

english.definition: an inclination to weigh both views or opinions equally

entries.definition: Que muestra poca decisión o ánimo ante las dificultades.
entries.example: El protagonista se reprocha su actitud pusilánime cuando evita defender a su compañero.
entries.levelRationale: Critical evaluation of lack of courage in action, not shyness alone. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.placementRationale: The self-reproach over failing to defend a colleague makes deficient resolve evaluative rather than a neutral description of fear.

english.definition: lacking courage; ignobly timid and faint-hearted
examples: "cowardly dogs, ye will not aid me then"- P.B.Shelley

entries.definition: Temor o inquietud ante la posibilidad de que ocurra algo desagradable.
entries.example: Entró en el edificio con aprensión, sin saber qué noticias le esperaban.
entries.levelRationale: Anticipatory unease, not comprehension or arrest. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.placementRationale: The unknown news motivates anticipatory unease, distinguished from response to a confirmed adverse event.

english.definition: fearful expectation or anticipation
examples: the student looked around the examination room with apprehension

entries.definition: Inquietud o malestar interior que impide sentirse en calma.
entries.example: La conversación le dejó una desazón que no logró explicar de inmediato.
entries.levelRationale: Diffuse emotional unrest without a specified bodily illness. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.placementRationale: The unexplained lingering disturbance identifies diffuse inner unease rather than a named concrete fear.

evidence.paraphrase: Interior unease directly supports the lingering distress after a conversation.

entries.definition: Falta de disposición para esforzarse o actuar.
entries.example: La narradora atribuye a la indolencia del personaje los asuntos que deja siempre pendientes.
entries.levelRationale: Inactivity from lack of willingness, not inability caused by exhaustion. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.placementRationale: The narrator attributes unfinished matters to a disposition against effort, a character judgment distinct from one accidental omission.

english.definition: inactivity resulting from a dislike of work

entries.definition: Que actúa o se expresa con reserva y atención a las circunstancias.
entries.example: Se mostró circunspecto al comentar una noticia que todavía no había podido comprobar.
entries.levelRationale: Reserved caution under uncertainty, not certainty that something is false. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.placementRationale: The unverified-news example ties reserve to judgment about circumstances rather than simple unwillingness to speak.

english.definition: heedful of potential consequences
examples: circumspect actions
physicians are now more circumspect about recommending its use
a discreet investor

entries.definition: Que cambia fácilmente de deseo, opinión o propósito.
entries.example: Su carácter veleidoso hacía difícil saber si mantendría el plan al día siguiente.
entries.levelRationale: Capricious changeability, not reasoned revision after new evidence. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.placementRationale: The uncertain plan illustrates unstable intention, not a deliberate revision based on new evidence.

english.definition: marked by erratic changeableness in affections or attachments
examples: fickle friends
a flirt's volatile affections

entries.definition: Información que se considera compartida sin haberla expresado de forma explícita.
entries.example: El desacuerdo nació de un sobreentendido: cada parte daba por hecha una fecha distinta.
entries.levelRationale: Assumed shared meaning that may actually diverge between speakers. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.register: written or spoken discourse; see selected use
entries.placementRationale: The conflicting assumed dates show how unspoken shared-information claims can fail, distinct from explicit agreement.

evidence.paraphrase: The noun is an unexpressed assumption in a statement or conversation; the longer spelling is explicitly accepted.

entries.definition: Información que una expresión da por aceptada como punto de partida.
entries.example: La pregunta contenía una presuposición discutible: que ya se había producido un incumplimiento.
entries.levelRationale: Background assumption carried by wording, not a conclusion established by evidence. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.register: written or spoken discourse; see selected use
entries.placementRationale: The question assumes an unestablished breach, requiring separation of its asserted query from its taken-for-granted premise.

english.definition: an assumption that is taken for granted

entries.definition: Confusión que surge al interpretar de forma distinta una palabra o una situación.
entries.example: El equívoco se resolvió cuando aclararon a cuál de los dos proyectos se refería el correo.
entries.levelRationale: Actual interpretive misunderstanding, distinct from a structurally ambiguous wording alone. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.register: written or spoken discourse; see selected use
entries.placementRationale: The two possible projects locate confusion in interpretation of reference, not necessarily a false factual assertion.

evidence.paraphrase: The masculine noun for confusion supports misunderstanding which project was meant, without implying deliberate evasion.

entries.definition: Con una intención indirecta que va más allá del sentido aparente de lo dicho.

entries.translation: so skrytým podtónom; s postranným zámerom
entries.levelRationale: Indirect pointed intention, not automatically malicious deception. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.placementRationale: The punctuality question conveys an indirect reproach beyond its literal inquiry.

evidence.paraphrase: The expression is explicitly used for a second intention, supporting the question's hidden reproach.

entries.definition: Se usa para expresar mucha confianza en que algo es o será cierto.
entries.example: A buen seguro, la propuesta suscitará preguntas que todavía no hemos previsto.
entries.levelRationale: Speaker confidence marker, not a guarantee supported by proof. Editorial selection for advanced contextual vocabulary practice; C2 placement is provisional, not an exclusive acquisition level or an official word-level assignment.
entries.placementRationale: The predicted questions are presented with strong speaker confidence, not a guarantee of objective certainty.

entries.placementRationale: The announcement frames a requirement as shared or obvious, rather than literally declining to express it.

entries.definition: Propio y singular de una persona o entidad concreta.

entries.levelRationale: Requiere distinguir rasgos individualizadores de lo meramente extraño o excéntrico.
entries.placementRationale: The distinctive personal method concerns individualizing character rather than simple strangeness or eccentricity.

entries.definition: Incompatible o falto de correspondencia con su contexto.

entries.levelRationale: Permite evaluar incompatibilidades contextuales o lógicas con mayor precisión que «inadecuado».
entries.placementRationale: The funeral tone example requires judging contextual incompatibility, not an isolated negative property.

entries.definition: Comprensible únicamente mediante conocimientos secretos, raros o misteriosos.

entries.placementRationale: The initiated readers and specialized symbolism make restricted comprehensibility central, rather than general difficulty.

entries.definition: Moralmente despreciable y merecedor del máximo rechazo.

entries.placementRationale: The attack on defenseless people carries extreme moral condemnation rather than ordinary disapproval.

entries.definition: Dispuesto a adaptarse o hacer concesiones por conveniencia.

entries.placementRationale: The negotiator's concessions express convenience-driven adaptability, distinguishing flexibility from principled agreement.

entries.definition: Que causa deshonra pública o merece una condena vergonzosa.

entries.levelRationale: Expresa deshonra pública grave con una intensidad retórica superior a «vergonzoso».

entries.definition: De dimensiones enormes y estructura pesada o desmesurada.

entries.levelRationale: Metáfora lexicalizada que combina tamaño descomunal y pesadez, útil en crítica institucional avanzada.
entries.placementRationale: The bureaucratic apparatus illustrates an exaggerated size-and-unwieldiness metaphor rather than literal zoological scale.

entries.definition: Arrepentido sinceramente por una falta y afligido por haberla cometido.

entries.levelRationale: Distingue el arrepentimiento moral profundo de la mera tristeza o disculpa convencional.
entries.placementRationale: The request for forgiveness combines admitted fault and felt remorse, rather than merely appearing sad.

entries.definition: Excesivamente escrupuloso en observar detalles, reglas o formalidades.

entries.levelRationale: Añade escrupulosidad excesiva respecto de minucias o formalidades, no mera atención cuidadosa.
entries.placementRationale: The greeting protocol exposes excessive scrupulousness about formalities, distinguishing it from generally careful work.

entries.definition: Exageradamente recatado ante asuntos relacionados con el sexo o el cuerpo.

entries.levelRationale: Designa recato exagerado con ironía o censura, matiz pragmático ausente en «tímido».
entries.placementRationale: The censorship of innocent allusions shows exaggerated sexual modesty and the evaluative stance carried by the adjective.

entries.definition: Opuesto radicalmente a otra idea, cualidad o finalidad.

entries.levelRationale: Formula oposición conceptual estructural, más rigurosa que una simple diferencia o discrepancia.
entries.placementRationale: The transparency example identifies radical incompatibility between a mechanism and a principle, not a simple difference.

entries.definition: Realizado a escondidas y procurando no ser descubierto.
entries.example: Detectaron un acceso subrepticio a los archivos confidenciales.
entries.levelRationale: Expresa ocultación deliberada y cautelosa, con frecuente relevancia jurídica o institucional.
entries.placementRationale: The concealed file access concerns avoiding discovery, with an interpretive distinction from something merely private.

entries.definition: Dominado por un deseo sexual excesivo o expresado con lascivia.

entries.placementRationale: The literary characterization identifies lascivious desire and conduct, preserving the marked evaluative register.

entries.definition: Muy experimentado y hábil en una actividad concreta.

alternativeForms.note: Forma femenina usada en el ejemplo.

entries.placementRationale: The interrogation example foregrounds practiced expertise in a particular activity rather than abstract intelligence.

entries.definition: De manera deshonrosa, humillante o merecedora de desprecio público.

entries.placementRationale: The military withdrawal is evaluated as publicly dishonorable, with a manner judgment beyond an ordinary defeat.

entries.definition: Reprender a alguien por una conducta considerada incorrecta.

entries.placementRationale: The campaign example conveys severe defamatory attack rather than neutral criticism or private disagreement.

entries.definition: Sentir y expresar una aversión o condena moral extremas.

entries.levelRationale: Verbo muy marcado que une repugnancia intensa y condena moral, más fuerte que «detestar».
entries.placementRationale: The philosopher's stance selects extreme moral rejection, distinct from an ordinary dislike or a criticism of one argument.

entries.definition: Ganarse deliberadamente la simpatía o buena disposición de alguien.

entries.placementRationale: The flattering approach to the jury makes deliberate favor-seeking central and distinct from merely getting along.

entries.definition: Abundar y moverse numerosos seres o elementos en un lugar.

entries.placementRationale: The corridor crowd evokes abundant animate movement, an expressive collective scene beyond a numerical count.

entries.definition: Acción o comportamiento grotesco propio de quien busca provocar risa.

entries.levelRationale: Su fuerte valoración peyorativa y resonancia teatral permiten una crítica estilísticamente marcada.
entries.placementRationale: The collapse of solemnity into grotesque performance expresses a critical evaluation rather than a neutral joke label.

entries.definition: Generosidad extraordinaria al conceder bienes, premios o favores.

entries.levelRationale: Es una denominación infrecuente y solemne de generosidad material excepcional, útil para estilos elevados.
entries.placementRationale: The patron's support demonstrates extraordinary material generosity, distinguishable from forgiveness in magnánimo.

entries.definition: Deslealtad grave que quebranta de forma deliberada la confianza ajena.

entries.definition: Relato breve, frecuentemente alegórico, que transmite una enseñanza moral.

entries.definition: Intervención inicial calculada para obtener ventaja en una conversación o negociación.

entries.levelRationale: Traslada una apertura ajedrecística al manejo estratégico del discurso y exige reconocer esa intención pragmática.
entries.placementRationale: The initial compliment is interpreted as a calculated conversational opening, not a literal chess move.

entries.definition: Deseo competitivo de igualar o superar los logros ajenos.

entries.placementRationale: The researchers' competition targets matching or surpassing another's accomplishments rather than copying appearances.

entries.definition: Ejército o conjunto numeroso de partidarios, especialmente en textos antiguos.

entries.definition: Estado de exaltación en que una emoción domina por completo a alguien.

entries.placementRationale: The aria example describes emotional absorption that overwhelms attention, rather than an ordinary positive reaction.

entries.definition: Ostentación de riqueza mediante un lujo extraordinario y espectacular.

entries.placementRationale: The banquet's reception highlights ostentatious luxury and its social effect, distinct from simple comfort or generosity.

entries.definition: Que anuncia o sugiere desgracias o consecuencias funestas.

entries.placementRationale: The silence example conveys anticipation of misfortune, beyond a general danger label; a useful connotative distinction in narrative interpretation.

entries.definition: Que establece normas o indica cómo debe actuarse.
